LightningComponentBundle.description: Flow screen component that collects the signers for a SignZero envelope.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: The record the envelope is sent from; its contacts are offered as signers.

property.name: accountId
property.label: Account Id
property.description: Optional. An account whose contacts are offered as signers too, for records that reach their account indirectly.
